name: markdown-preview
description: Open a rendered version of the Markdown in the current editor with `ctrl-shift-m`.

breakOnSingleNewline.description: In Markdown, a single newline character doesn't cause a line break in the generated HTML. In GitHub Flavored Markdown, that is not true. Enable this config option to insert line breaks in rendered HTML for single newlines in Markdown source.

liveUpdate.description: Re-render the preview as the contents of the source changes, without requiring the source buffer to be saved. If disabled, the preview is re-rendered only when the buffer is saved to disk.

openPreviewInSplitPane.description: Open the preview in a split pane. If disabled, the preview is opened in a new tab in the same pane.

openInPreviewByDefault.description: Open Markdown files as a rendered preview instead of the editor. Use `markdown-preview:toggle` (`ctrl-shift-m`) to switch between the preview and the editable source.

showDiff.description: Render a diff against the git `HEAD` version (added/removed shown inline). Toggle with `markdown-preview:toggle-diff` (`ctrl-shift-d`). This setting is global and persists across reloads.

diffMergeMaxWords.description: In diff mode, merge word-level changes separated by fewer than this many unchanged words into a single removed/added chunk (a coarser, line-like diff). 0 keeps the (refined) word-level diff.

diffRewriteThreshold.description: In diff mode, when more than this percentage of a paragraph's text changed, show the old and the new paragraph whole (one removed, one added) instead of a word diff that interleaves them. 0 always keeps the word diff.

diffAgainstStaged.description: In diff mode, compare the working copy against the staged (index) version — what `git diff` shows — instead of the last commit (HEAD).

allowUnsafeProtocols.description: Allow HTML attributes to use protocols normally considered unsafe such as `file://` and absolute paths on Windows.

grammars.description: List of scopes for languages for which previewing is enabled. See [this README](https://github.com/pulsar-edit/spell-check#readme) for more information on finding the correct scope for a specific language.

useGitHubStyle.title: Use GitHub.com Style
useGitHubStyle.description: Use the same CSS styles for preview as the ones used on GitHub.com.

gitHubStyleMode.title: GitHub.com Style Mode
gitHubStyleMode.description: Whether to use light-mode GitHub CSS, dark-mode GitHub CSS, or system default (based on your operating system preferences). Has no effect unless **Use GitHub.com Style** is enabled.

syntaxHighlightingLanguageIdentifier.title: Syntax Highlighting Language Identifiers
syntaxHighlightingLanguageIdentifier.description: Syntax Highlighting System to use for code block language identification. See [the README](https://github.com/pulsar-edit/pulsar/tree/master/packages/markdown-preview#readme) for details.

customSyntaxHighlightingLanguageIdentifi.description: Comma-separated list of syntax language identifiers to map to any language. See [the README](https://github.com/pulsar-edit/pulsar/tree/master/packages/markdown-preview#readme) for usage.

useOriginalParser.description: When checked, will use the original Markdown parser for `markdown-preview` (`marked`). When unchecked, will use the new Markdown parser built into Pulsar (`markdown-it`).
